rci3_epd_name.answer: HCP; ABIDE; Cam-CAN; UK Biobank; OASIS; ADNI; PNC; ABCD; IXI; NKI; HBN; COBRE; AIBL
rci3_epd_name.detail: HCP (Human Connectome Project, Young Adult and HCP Aging/Development listed separately); ABIDE (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange); Cam-CAN (Cambridge Centre for Aging and Neuroscience, N=648, ages 18–88); UK Biobank (large imaging cohort, processed with FreeSurfer 6.0.1); OASIS3 (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies); ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative); PNC (Philadelphia Neuroimaging Cohort, single 3T Siemens scanner); ABCD (Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development, 21 sites, N=10,588 downloaded); IXI; NKI (Nathan Kline Institute Rockland Sample); HBN (Healthy Brain Network); COBRE (Center for Biomedical Research Excellence, 3T Siemens, via SchizConnect); AIBL (Australian Imaging Biomarkers and Lifestyle). TOP, LEAP, REST-meta-MDD, FCON not identified in Section 19 dataset list.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: Dataset TOC in supplementary lists: "ABCD", "ABIDE", "ADNI", "AIBL", "Cam-CAN", "COBRE", "HBN", "Human Connectome Project", "IXI", "NKI – Nathan Kline Institute Rockland Sample", "OASIS3", "PNC", "UKB – UK Biobank"
rci3_epd_name.location: Bethlehem2021_sup.pdf.md: Section 19 TOC, L93–L184; individual dataset descriptions L1212–L1750

model-1.model-name: normative models for cerebrum tissue volumes and extended global/regional MRI phenotypes (GMV, WMV, sGMV, Ventricles, SA, CT, 34 regional volumes)

rci5_n.detail: CN-specific N for GAMLSS normative model not reported in main text or supplementary text; exact N per phenotype is in Supplementary Tables ST1.2–1.8 (not available in the accessed files). Total aggregated dataset (CN + Dx): 123,984 MRI scans from 101,457 participants across 100 studies. Different phenotypes have different CN Ns (noted in Fig. 1 caption referencing ST1.2–1.8).
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Demographics for each cross-sectional sample of healthy controls included in the reference dataset for normative GAMLSS modelling of each MRI phenotype are detailed in Supplementary Table 1.2-1.8"
